The best PS Plus Extra games

PS Plus Extra has over 450 games in its catalogue, and the best of them are some of the finest games ever made. These are the ten with the highest Metascores right now, with a few words on each and how long the main story takes, so you can pick one that fits the time you have. The full ranked list follows, and it updates by itself whenever Sony adds or removes games.

What's in PS Plus Extra

PS Plus Extra is the tier that adds the Game Catalogue: a library of PS4 and PS5 games you can download and play for as long as you stay subscribed. Sony adds games every month and removes some, so the catalogue is always changing.

This list only counts games in that catalogue, so everything on it is playable with Extra or Premium today. The PS1, PS2, PSP and PS3 classics that need Premium have a list of their own. Our ten are the highest Metascores, with repeat editions of the same game left out so you get ten different games rather than three versions of one.

1

Persona 5 Royal

PS5 · Metascore 95 · 98% recommend on OpenCritic · about 101 h main story

By day you're a transfer student in Tokyo, juggling classes, part-time jobs and friendships. By night you and your friends become the Phantom Thieves, slipping into the twisted inner worlds of corrupt adults to steal their hearts. It's a long, stylish, turn-based RPG with one of the best soundtracks around, and Royal is the expanded version with a whole extra semester.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

2

God of War

PS4 · Metascore 94 · 97% recommend on OpenCritic · about 21 h main story

Kratos leaves Greek myth behind for the Norse wilds, where he sets out with his young son Atreus to scatter his wife's ashes from the highest peak. The axe combat is heavy and satisfying, and the story of a hard father learning to raise his kid gives it real weight. Start here before Ragnarök.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

3

God of War Ragnarok

PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 94 · 96% recommend on OpenCritic · about 26 h main story

The sequel picks up a few years later as Fimbulwinter grips the world and Ragnarök draws near. It's bigger in every way, with more realms, more ways to fight and a larger cast, but it still comes back to Kratos and Atreus.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

4

The Last of Us Part II Remastered

PS5 · Metascore 93 · about 23 h main story

Five years after the first game, Ellie sets out across a ruined Seattle on a quest for revenge, and the story asks hard questions about what that costs. The tense stealth and scavenging are some of the best in the genre, but it's a heavy, violent story. The PS5 version adds No Return, a replayable survival mode.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

5

Uncharted 4: A Thief's End

PS4 · Metascore 93 · 97% recommend on OpenCritic · about 15 h main story

Nathan Drake is pulled out of retirement by the brother he thought was dead, for one last hunt after a legendary pirate treasure. It's a blockbuster adventure of climbing, gunfights and set pieces, with warm, funny characters holding it together.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

6

Bloodborne

PS4 · Metascore 92 · about 32 h main story

FromSoftware's gothic nightmare sends you through the plague-ridden city of Yharnam, hunting beasts that get stranger the deeper you go. The combat is fast and rewards aggression rather than hiding behind a shield. It's hard and makes no apologies, but few games feel this rewarding once it clicks, and it's a PlayStation exclusive.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

7

Blue Prince

PS5 · Metascore 92 · about 18 h main story

You've inherited a mansion whose rooms rearrange every day, and you pick each new room from a hand of options as you open each door, looking for the rumoured 46th room. It's a puzzle game full of clues, codes and secrets that keeps surprising you long after the credits.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

8

Demon's Souls

PS5 · Metascore 92 · about 24 h main story

A ground-up PS5 remake of the 2009 game that started the Souls series, from the team at Bluepoint. You fight through the cursed kingdom of Boletaria, one dangerous level at a time. It looks stunning and is a gentler way into FromSoftware's style than Bloodborne, though only just.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

9

Rayman Legends

PS4 · Metascore 92 · about 10 h main story

A bright, inventive 2D platformer that's easy to pick up and great with up to four players on one couch. The musical levels, where you run and jump in time with the soundtrack, are the highlight.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

10

Undertale

PS4 · Metascore 92 · 97% recommend on OpenCritic · about 7 h main story

A small RPG with a big reputation. You fall into an underground world of monsters, and you can talk your way out of every fight instead of winning it. It's funny, strange and surprisingly moving, and the choices you make change how it all plays out.

Questions

What's the best game on PS Plus Extra?

By Metascore, it's Persona 5 Royal, at 95. If you'd rather not commit 100 hours, God of War is just behind it at 94 and takes about 21 hours.

How many games are in PS Plus Extra?

There are 451 games in the Game Catalog right now. Sony adds a batch every month and removes a few, so the number moves around.

What's the difference between PS Plus Essential and Extra?

Essential gives you online multiplayer and a few monthly games to claim. Extra adds the Game Catalog: hundreds of PS4 and PS5 games you can download and play for as long as you're subscribed. Premium adds the Classics, game trials and cloud streaming on top.

Do I keep PS Plus Extra games if I cancel?

No. Catalog games stay playable only while you subscribe at the Extra tier or higher. Your saves stay, so you can pick up where you left off if you come back.

Do games leave PS Plus Extra?

Yes, most months. Sony usually confirms which games are leaving a few weeks ahead, and our leaving soon list tracks them.

What's a great short game on PS Plus Extra?

Undertale takes about 7 hours and Celeste about 8, and both are among the best-rated games on the service. Our short games list has more.
